items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Butter as we called him, told me -- it was on some things there was no first trumpet part... He had Clarke Terry, Shorty Baker, Ray Nance and Cat Anderson.

ctx.x: And Butter was so happy. And Kenny would have done it, you know, had there been time.

Yeah. But I had no idea, you know, that Butter -- I knew his health had been shaky, but I had no idea that -- because he just didn't seem like it, as he was telling those stories when we went out to dinner?
Yeah. No, he seemed in fine spirits, like he felt good, and I think he did feel good then.
